aboutSection.title: A Community Built to Explore, Connect & Create
aboutSection.description: The Applied Mechanics Student Association is the official student-led community of the Department of Applied Mechanics and Biomedical Engineering, IIT Madras. We bring together students across the department to learn, collaborate, innovate, and grow. From academic resources and research initiatives to talks, workshops, and industry interactions, we create opportunities to take learning beyond the classroom.
